ENGINEERING INSPECTION REPORT
Date of Inspection: January 15, 2026
Property: 123 Main St, Dallas TX

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:
The roof system was inspected following a reported hail event on December 20, 2025. Our inspection identified granule loss and minor indentation on the asphalt shingles. The damage observed is cosmetic only and does not affect the functional performance of the roofing system. The shingles remain weather-tight and capable of shedding water. No test square analysis was performed as the damage was not deemed significant enough to warrant further investigation.

FINDINGS:
We observed scattered impact marks on soft metal vents and flashing. The shingle surfaces showed granule displacement in isolated areas. No mat fracture or brittle fracture was identified during our visual inspection. We did not perform destructive testing or core cuts. The overall condition of the roof reflects normal aging and expected service life deterioration. The granule loss pattern is consistent with weathering rather than hail impact. No functional damage was identified.

CONCLUSION:
The observed conditions are the result of normal wear and tear and aging of the roofing materials. The cosmetic damage does not warrant replacement. We recommend continued monitoring and routine maintenance.
